lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on several winning home wait_info and adoption redesign tests.
Adding new screens at adoption or finish stages consistently hurt performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful.
Updating home wait_info frequently generated wins (5 wins), though many tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy changes (4 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for change types with only one test or conflicting outcomes.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Chooser Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout featuring distinct comparison choice cards for quick companion creation versus full customization.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s; presenting clean structured side-by-side choices helps undecided users pick faster.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Dynamic Render Milestone Indicator
candidates.change: Display a dynamic progress bar and estimated timer component on the generation waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
candidates.why: The home waiting stage has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; updating wait info has yielded 5 prior wins by reducing perceived wait frustration.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicator and real-time wait estimate is allowed on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home step loses only 5.7% of users, but wait info updates have a strong track record of 5 historical wins (+1.3% mean lift).

candidates.title: Spotlight Pet Choice Studio
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a spotlight layout with focused preview assets and trait badges.
candidates.why: Redesigning the adoption stage previously yielded multiple test wins, and enhancing visual clarity helps users finalize their adoption choice cleanly.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a badge cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Stage Visual Waiting Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with centered mascot animation and real-time status updates.
candidates.why: Long tail waiting times (mean 2336s) cause user drop-off; engaging centered visuals keep users entertained while background generation completes.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Adoption-First Sign-In Sequence Shift
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 25% of users early; letting users select their companion first builds emotional investment prior to account creation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in step after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 25% of users, but structural reordering requires significant release effort and reorder tests show modest historical lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Background Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notifications when rendering completes and display copy reassuring users they can minimize the app.
candidates.why: Mean time on the waiting stage is over 38 minutes; users leave the window open without knowing they can safely minimize it.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet arrives!

guard.reason: Adding background desktop notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addressing the 38-minute mean wait time is backed by funnel data, but notification changes historically show mixed to negative results.

candidates.title: Account Preservation Sign-In Clarification
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and hint to clarify that logging into an existing account restores saved pets and prevents reset issues.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets after signing back in with different credentials.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.hint: Logging in ensures your existing pets are restored and saved safely to your account.

guard.reason: Clarifying copy on the sign-in screen is allowed and does not violate any rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 25% sign-in drop and 8 support emails, but copy changes consistently fail to generate positive lift.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Mascot Hero Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the story intro screen using a story_scroll layout featuring animated pet previews and hero introduction text.
candidates.why: Choose_path redesigns historically perform well; an engaging story introduction sets strong expectations before path selection.

intro_story.text: Meet your interactive desktop companion, ready to keep you company and assist daily.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Clarity Helper
candidates.change: Add photo lighting and background requirements hint to the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet generation failures or corrupted visual outputs.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation results, upload a well-lit, front-facing photo with a clear subject and neutral background.

candidates.title: Split Desktop Controls Overview
candidates.change: Switch home_intro to a split layout showcasing quick desktop pet interaction controls and tray visibility tips.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing/opening and 3 about confusion over how to control or hide the pet after onboarding.

components.text: Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the pet to open controls or double-click to hide.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 29.1% and support emails confirm user confusion, but past finish layout changes consistently showed no clear effect.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated top-performing wins in adoption redesign and home wait_info.
Adding new screens at the adoption or finish stages consistently reduced performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, while home redesigns (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Updating home wait_info frequently generated wins (5 wins), though many tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy (4 tests), finish layout (3 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and choose_path new screens (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for change types with only one test or conflicting outcomes (such as finish redesigns and sign-in reordering).
